notes.title: When the Past was Around OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/cc15118b552235c6d82d2fae5de5857f6feba976.png[/img]

IT’S HERE!

After more than a year of hardwork, good days and bad days, it’s finally here! [b]When the Past was Around[/b] is out now on Steam and you can now enjoy the bittersweet story of Eda and Owl. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and find out the mystery of the past.

Watch the launch trailer here.
https://youtu.be/ZnpO8z0yMCQ

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

Once again, we want to thank [b][i]you[/i][/b] for all your support throughout the development of this game, for all the love that you have shown… Thank you. To our friends, family, to the awesome beta testers, to our beloved community and supporters, thank you so so so much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/ddee2241be4737fe045a35f11da3ea2d7fae3969.gif[/img]

We are very delighted to announce that our project, [b]When the Past was Around[/b] by Mojiken Studio and Toge Productions will be available on Steam on September 22, 2020.

notes.title: When the Past was Around won Best Game Award
notes.content:
Yay! We still can’t believe it!

We are truly happy and truly honored to receive this award. It was past 11 pm when the live stream happened and we were so surprised when we heard the announcement. We want to thank Indie Arena Booth Online organizers and the judges and giving this honorable award to us.

All of us at Mojiken Studio and Toge Productions are very happy and grateful that When the Past was Around won [b]Best Game Award[/b] in [b]Indie Arena Booth Online 2020[/b] at [b]Gamescom[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/183896215095fa14e0f3092107928b800108342d.jpg[/img]

We want to give shout-out to the games who were also nominated for Best Game Award. They’re all great games and we love them! Do check out these games belove and share some love by following or adding the games to your wishlist if you like them

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062140/Garden_Story/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094920/Hazel_Sky/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128920/EVERSPACE_2/

Before we end the announcement, here are a couple exciting news for you!
[list]
[*] We just finished closed beta-test for the game. We want to thank our community especially Toge Productions’ Discord server community for the help!
[*] That being said, the game will probably be ready soon! Of course, we still need time to improve and polish the game after the receiving feedback and reports from the beta-test.
[*] And here’s a couple screenshots of When the Past was Around full game!

notes.title: Devlog #03: Sneak Peek Video of the Full Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/5fda0a80c3356d2f9c5b4b5d8018e2753daee3f1.png[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]

How are you? XD

Lately we’ve been joining lots of online events, so it’s pretty hectic for us these days. But we’re glad that we’ve been receiving lots of love, also from [b]Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition[/b] last month. Thanks to everyone who came and watched the stream!

Before the Steam Game Festival, we also participated in [i]Wholesome Direct[/i] where we showcased exclusive footage from the full game of [b]When the Past was Around[/b]. We thought maybe we can share the video we submitted here, too!

Check out the full-game footage on the video below!
https://youtu.be/ErAc0fK8DJU

And here’s the link to the full direct video.
https://youtu.be/AwCNzOPR8Ck?t=1088

Soooo… After watching the video, are you excited? Tell us in the comment section!

Oh, right! We also have some news from [b]When the Past was Around[/b]!
The game will be published in Japan by awesome team from Chorus Worldwide and they will also help us with the release and distribution on Nintendo Switch eShop, PS4, and Xbox One! So, yes! We’re coming to consoles as well! Yay yaaayyyy!

Last but not least, we finally have our own Twitter account!
So please follow us on Twitter! <3

TWITTER : http://twitter.com/WPWAgame

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/53cf9667bc7cd2d1324267c6a4dc2bbe83e9106c.png[/img]

[h1]Cross-Promo Time![/h1]

And please also wishlist this upcoming game from our studio, [b]A Space for the Unbound[/b]!
A slice-of-life adventure game set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers.

If you love When the Past was Around, you will probably love this game, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

That’s is for now! We’ll see you on the next devlog!

With love,
Owl Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog: Early Concept Sketches
notes.content:
Hello again!

Hope everyone is doing well.

On this devlog, we will be sharing early concept sketches that you’ll see in the game and the one you will not see as well :p

[h2]Kota Tua[/h2]
These are the early concept sketches for the city scene on[b] When The Past Was Around[/b]. To bring out a melancholic atmosphere, we took some architectural references from Surabaya “Kota Tua” district. “Kota Tua” lliterally means old city. Also, we use lots of Indonesian-Dutch Colonial ornamental and architectural influences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/43d232d636d68e925d131c2b52c82203cf254d60.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/99d05c6025445a4fe3428812503d5e53b9d782ff.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/1f0f1c2ad9857643bf8a40416fe0c9bfef6d06a5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Plants[/h2]
If you’ve been with us since [i]A Raven Monologue[/i] and [i]She and the Light Bearer,[/i] you’ll know that I love plants so much. I just can’t help but put as many plants as possible in every environment. Even the city got its own garden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/c4a0df66ac419f1850fcfec2969b013e731ce3da.jpg[/img]

You'll find lots of plants and foliage later almost everywhere in the game, so be prepared for that XD

[h2]Scrap[/h2]
Last but not least, here’s the sketch of unused puzzles and environments. This is an exclusive content because you won’t find this in the game hehe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36045652/a3ab93604976d527f641f0e85d1dc790dd6c7edc.jpg[/img]

- - - - -

That’s all!

Please let me know if there’s anything you want me to share on the next devlog. I’d be happy to share them with all of you :) And if you want to see more sketches, please follow me on Twitter here: [url=http://twitter.com/crystalnyam]twitter.com/crystalnyam[/url]

And don't forget to wishlist the full game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164050/When_The_Past_Was_Around/

With love,
Rena and Owl Team
